title: chrysanthemum cilicium
intro: Chrysanthemum cilicium, commonly known as Goldflower or Yellow chrysanthemum, is a plant species native to the Cilician region of Asia Minor. The health benefits of this plant include its use as a diuretic, anti-inflammatory, and antiseptic agent, which can help with conditions such as fever reduction, skin disorders, and urinary infections. The therapeutic actions of Chrysanthemum cilicium include its ability to calm and soothe the nervous system, making it useful for treating anxiety and insomnia. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
